text:
Elaine: Quick sync — Week 2 of the launch drip is going out next Tue/Wed. Need final APAC send windows, subject line variants, and the webinar benchmark CTA. Who's owning what?

Matt: I can own the segmentation logic and audience pruning. Planning: new users last 90d, trialers, and pilot partners.

Ria: I’ll draft subject lines. Thinking three flavors: curiosity, social proof, and product-led. Will post options by EOD. cc @Elaine :pencil2: 

Devon: For APAC we should avoid 0100-0500 JST send. Best windows: 09:00-11:00 JST or 18:00-20:00 JST. Which one is preferred for engagement?

Elaine: Good call. Let’s do the evening window for APAC (18:00-20:00 JST) for the main drip, morning window for transactional reminders.

Matt: Segmentation question — do we route webinar invites to everyone or only trial + active users? I vote trial + active for primary, newsletter-only get a lighter nudge (single email).

Ria: Agreed. For the three-email drip: 1) Launch announcement + hero stat, 2) Benchmark highlight + CTA to webinar, 3) Last-chance + short testimonial. Each with 2 subject variants.

Sam: Scheduling snippet for campaign config (will load to CampaignManager):

```
campaign: launch-week2
segments:
  - name: trials_90d
  - name: active_customers
send_windows:
  - region: APAC
    window: 18:00-20:00 JST
  - region: NA
    window: 09:00-11:00 PT
variants:
  subjects: ["curiosity_a","social_b"]
```

Matt: Will implement the audience pruning rules and run a dry run list by tomorrow morning.

Ria: Subject candidates (shortlist):
- Curiosity: "A faster way to serve LLMs — benchmark inside"
- Social: "Used by X teams to cut inference cost 3x"
- Product-led: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency"

Elaine: Love those. Ria — can you create the final subject A/B matrix and pin in the doc? Link: https://redwoodhq.internal/docs/launch-week2 (internal)

Devon: One more ask — include APAC-friendly imagery and local times in the emails. I'll provide localized copy by EOD tomorrow.

email-bot: Scheduled preview send for trial_90d segment to internal list at 1733335000 for QA.

Sam: After QA, we should enable the send throttles: 1000/min initial, ramp to 5000/min. That keeps deliverability safe.

Matt: Noted. I'll post the export of the dry-run list here once ready.

Elaine: Thanks team. Action items: Matt = segmentation + dry-run list; Ria = final subjects + copy tweaks; Devon = APAC localization; Sam = scheduling + throttles. Check-in tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
